message: Top findings of the first code review (scored 60-75 by a fresh scorer; none reached the 80 cut, so they're todos, not defects on record). (proposal 01a10a57-624a-776b-af0e-78285f9f65a7, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

title: Make catalog-tree Split and Merge atomic
body: Split (trees.rs ~396) adds the parts one by one with `?` before retiring the original; Merge (~419) adds the target, then moves children one at a time. A failure partway (two parts named alike, a sibling-name clash between merged nodes' children, a Leaf target with children) returns Err with the tree already changed, and log::apply_batch keeps the half-applied state beside the Conflict. Validate everything first, or apply to a copy. Add tests for each failure.

title: Graph create: check the name against names only, not id prefixes
body: Graphs::find (graphs/mod.rs ~721) falls back to an id-prefix match, and GraphOp::Create (~500) uses it for its 'already named' check, so a new graph named e.g. "beef" or "0" is rejected when some UUID starts that way. Update (~509) compares names only, so the two disagree.

title: An observer's NodeRemove/EdgeRemove must not remove stated props
body: NodeRemove (graphs/mod.rs ~628) and EdgeRemove (~711) check only the node's or edge's own source. An observed node can carry stated props (set_prop lets them land), and a scanner's remove then deletes them, against the rule 'An observation never overwrites or removes what was stated.' Refuse the removal when any prop is stated.

title: Graph walk and shortest_path: cost what they reach, not the graph
body: walk (graph.rs ~398) and shortest_path (~440) allocate `vec![_; self.nodes.len()]` per call, so a depth-1 neighbours query (knowledge query::neighbors, render's focus view) costs the whole graph. DESIGN.md 3.2 says O(nodes reached + their edges). Track seen slots sparsely (a small set or a reusable buffer), or correct the documented cost.
